info.title: Wink Partner Integrator API
info.description:
# Partner Integrator API
Authenticated, usage-metered access to bookable travel inventory for API integrators. Query
properties, availability and rates programmatically at scale under
/api/partner/{managingEntityIdentifier}/. Requests are counted and rate-limited per account:
a free tier applies until you subscribe to the metered paid tier. See the Partner API
pricing & SLA page for current limits, per-request pricing and terms.

membershipRateDiscount.description: A property's price score is based on calculating historical pricing data. Each property receives a unique score. There is no max score; it's there to compare it against other properties.

priceScore.description: A property's price score is based on calculating historical pricing data. Each property receives a unique score. There is no max score; it's there to compare it against other properties.

perkScore.description: A property's perk score is based on the type of perks that is offered to the guests across all master rates. There is no max score; it's there to compare it against other properties.

addOnScore.description: A property's package score is based on general availability and price for all packages and add-ons offered by the property. There is no max score; it's there to compare it against other properties.

loyaltyScore.description: A property's loyalty score is based on calculating how many available rate plans honor loyalty points. There is no max score; it's there to compare it against other properties.

popularScore.description: A property's popular score is based on calculating number of bookings across room types. There is no max score; it's there to compare it against other properties.

experienceScore.description: A property's experience score is based on how calculating how many types of experiences are available and at what price ranges. There is no max score; it's there to compare it against other properties.

disabilityFeatures.description: Supported OTA specification `PHY` code. See [OTA geoname data](#operation/showAvailableCodesForCategory)

securityFeatures.description: Supported OTA specification `SEC` code. See [OTA geoname data](#operation/showAvailableCodesForCategory)

socials.description: Social network accounts for blocking (if applicable).

applicableStart.description: Start month and day or date for which the attraction (e.g. the start of a season) is available. This date property signifies that the blocking is recurring and / or seasonal. If the date is in the past, only day and month will be used to infer seasonality. If the date is a future date, it will be interpreted as a starting date.

applicableEnd.description: End month and day or date for which the attraction (e.g. the start of a season) is available. This date property signifies that the blocking is recurring and / or seasonal. If the date is in the past, only day and month will be used to infer seasonality. If the date is a future date, it will be interpreted as a ending date.

reservationRequiredInd.description: Indicates whether a reservation is required to participate in this inventory.

opens.description: Opening time of blocking (if applicable). Leave empty if blocking is always available.

closes.description: Closing time of blocking (if applicable). Leave empty if blocking is always available.

daysOfWeek.description: Indicate which days this inventory is open.

amenities.description: OTA specification codes for spa amenities (massage types, facilities, wellness offerings, etc.)

channelInventoryIdentifier.description: Channel inventory identifier referencing this record.

commissionable.description: Whether this package is commissionable based on the incoming sales channel.
